title: Simple Pipe Work Component Fabrication
objective: Recognise the controlled information and quality concepts associated with simple pipework components.
safety_boundary: Conceptual pipework fabrication only; no cutting, joining, forming or installation procedures.

sections.heading: 1. Pipework components
sections.body: Pipework assemblies contain specified components whose dimensions and relationships are defined by controlled information.

sections.heading: 2. Drawings and specifications
sections.body: Approved drawings and specifications communicate component identity, dimensions and required relationships.

sections.heading: 3. Quality
sections.body: Fabricated components must be checked against applicable acceptance requirements.

sections.heading: 4. Practical boundary
sections.body: Actual pipework fabrication requires authorised practical training and supervision.

questions.question: Does this lesson teach cutting or joining procedures?
